title: A failed test is reported to the engine, and finalise runs after it and writes no contract.
why: behavioural spec 'execute': when the closure ends, 'report-variant' with the closure's verdict, 'failed' with 'reason' when it threw. Only the closure knows whether the consumer handled what it was sent, so it is reported, and the engine withholds a contract claiming a variant the consumer's own test failed on (Phase 9 finding 4, ADR 0064). 'finalise': the SDK keeps no record of which tests failed, and withholds no contract the engine answered; it fails naming every interaction whose status is not 'verified'. The integration MUST run 'finalise' after the suite's last 'execute', including when an 'execute' failed: sessions are the only resource (engine-protocol spec §7.1).
note: The scripted engine is told to withhold, as the real one does on a reported failure: what this case pins is that the SDK reported it, and that a withheld contract fails 'finalise'. 'live/failed-test-withholds-contract' is the same case against the real engine.

test.reason: Error: the consumer cannot handle variant 'shippedAt=absent'
